title: TON Strategy Co 8-K Filing — 2026-04-16
summary: TON Strategy Company filed a Form 8-K announcing the appointment of Kevin Wilson as Chief Executive Officer, effective May 4, 2026. Wilson brings over 20 years of fintech and global markets experience, including senior roles at Citi's FX division and most recently at Integral Development Corp. The filing discloses standard CEO employment terms including a $950,000 base salary, 100% target bonus, $250,000 signing bonus, and 2% equity grant.
key_points: Kevin Wilson appointed CEO of TON Strategy Company (Nasdaq: TONX), effective May 4, 2026
Wilson has 17 years of experience at Citi's Fixed Income, Currencies and Commodities division, co-founding the North American Margin FX Trading business
Most recently, Wilson led cryptocurrency trading and blockchain initiatives at Integral Development Corp., helping launch the world's first stablecoin-based prime brokerage service
Base salary: not less than $950,000 per year
Target annual bonus: 100% of base salary (guaranteed at target level for 2026; minimum 1/6 of target for 2027)
Signing bonus: $250,000; Long-term equity incentive: minimum 2% of fully diluted outstanding shares
